parse_levels_string: parse a semicolon or comma separated level string into a list of floats
filter_level_osm_element: filter an OSM element to exclude underground or non-ground-floor levels
is_area_osm_way: check if an OSM way represents a closed area like a building or park
match_to_group_label: match an OSM label string to a semantic group using regex patterns
group_elements_osm_data: group OSM nodes, ways, and areas into semantic categories like building, road, or tree
